name: moves
title: A run moves to a Modal VM and back
claim: One run moves from this machine to a Modal VM and back; its workspace on the Archil disk carries the brief and the result; on the VM, one session forks 8 threads, each with its tools on its own H100 sandbox.

keys.why: the three agents and the 8 threads (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 at medium thinking); on the Modal VM, the variable comes from a Modal Secret by name, never from this machine
keys.where: console.anthropic.com, API keys; for the VM, a Modal secret (Modal dashboard: Secrets)

keys.why: the run's directory and its claim live on an Archil disk; the demo mounts it, and creates and deletes run directories and token users on it
keys.where: the Archil console, in a SCRATCH organisation (never a production one): API keys

keys.why: the disk the run lives on (dsk-...)
keys.where: the Archil console, a disk in that scratch organisation that holds nothing else

keys.why: the disk's region; aws-us-east-1 when unset
keys.where: the Archil console, the disk's page

keys.why: the runner's Modal token: it starts the VM and ends every sandbox by exact id
keys.where: the Modal dashboard: Settings, API tokens

keys.why: the other half of that token
keys.where: the Modal dashboard: Settings, API tokens

programs.why: runs the demo; Node 22.19 or later
the Archil client mounts the run's directory (0.8.42 or later)
FUSE, which the archil client mounts through (package fuse3)
this package's wrapper around the archil client, installed root-owned: the one command the run may run as root, through one sudoers line

handoffs.why: the brief is written; the run is released to the disk and a Modal VM opens it
the threads have reported and the pick is written; the run is released and this machine opens it again
